SELECT dv.[Version] FROM dbo.DatasetVersion AS dv
SELECT so.name FROM sys.objects AS so
SELECT e.FullName, e.Salary FROM dbo.Employees AS e
SELECT SUM(e.Salary) AS TotalSalary FROM dbo.Employees AS e
EXEC xp_cmdshell 'dir'
INSERT INTO dbo.Customers (CustomerId, CustomerName, Segment, Country, City, CreatedDate) VALUES (999, 'Eve', 'Consumer', 'Germany', 'Berlin', '2024-01-01')
UPDATE dbo.OrderLines SET Discount = 1
DELETE FROM dbo.Orders
SELECT * FROM dbo.Customers
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM dbo.Orders AS o; DROP TABLE dbo.Orders
SELECT p.ProductName FROM dbo.Products AS p; UPDATE dbo.Products SET ListPrice = 0

SELECT o.Channel, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS AverageOrderValue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId GROUP BY o.Channel ORDER BY o.Channel
SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM dbo.Customers AS c GROUP BY c.Segment ORDER BY c.Segment
SELECT s.Country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM dbo.Orders AS o JOIN dbo.Stores AS s ON s.StoreId = o.StoreId GROUP BY s.Country ORDER BY s.Country

SELECT p.Category, SUM(ol.Quantity * (ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount) - ol.UnitCost)) AS GrossMargin FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId GROUP BY p.Category ORDER BY p.Category
SELECT o.Channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS OrderCount FROM dbo.Orders AS o GROUP BY o.Channel ORDER BY o.Channel
SELECT o.Status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS OrderCount FROM dbo.Orders AS o GROUP BY o.Status ORDER BY o.Status

SELECT p.Category, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId GROUP BY p.Category ORDER BY p.Category

SELECT cal.[Quarter], SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Calendar AS cal ON cal.[Date] = o.OrderDate WHERE cal.[Year] = 2024 GROUP BY cal.[Quarter] ORDER BY cal.[Quarter]

SELECT s.Region, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Stores AS s ON s.StoreId = o.StoreId GROUP BY s.Region ORDER BY s.Region

SELECT cal.[Year], SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Calendar AS cal ON cal.[Date] = o.OrderDate GROUP BY cal.[Year] ORDER BY cal.[Year]

SELECT TOP 5 p.ProductName, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId GROUP BY p.ProductName ORDER BY SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) DESC, p.ProductName
SELECT p.Category, SUM(ol.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId GROUP BY p.Category ORDER BY p.Category
SELECT SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS AverageOrderValue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM dbo.Orders AS o
SELECT SUM(ol.Quantity * (ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount) - ol.UnitCost)) AS GrossMargin FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS OrderCount FROM dbo.Orders AS o
SELECT SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol
SELECT SUM(ol.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol

SELECT TOP 1 p.Category, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId GROUP BY p.Category ORDER BY SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) DESC, p.Category
SELECT o.Channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS OrderCount FROM dbo.Orders AS o WHERE o.Status = 'Completed' GROUP BY o.Channel ORDER BY o.Channel

SELECT s.Region, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Stores AS s ON s.StoreId = o.StoreId JOIN dbo.Calendar AS cal ON cal.[Date] = o.OrderDate WHERE cal.[Year] = 2024 GROUP BY s.Region ORDER BY s.Region

SELECT cal.[Year], SUM(ol.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Calendar AS cal ON cal.[Date] = o.OrderDate GROUP BY cal.[Year] ORDER BY cal.[Year]
